Babalities. Friendships, and Animalities: Have no prerequisites in this game. Simply execute the finisher after you defeat your opponent and receive instruction to "Finish Him/Her" or "Prove Yourself".
Mercy: ), ( ) (Outside Sweep) Must be executed at the end of the third round.

Finisher Distances Explained:
Close: Right next to your opponent.
Sweep: A couple of steps away (close enough to land a sweep).
Outside Sweep: Just beyond sweep range.
Half Screen: About one jump distance away from your opponent.
Full Screen: As far apart as possible (opponent at the other side of the screen).
Anywhere: Distance doesn't matter, can be any range (outside sweep or further works best).

Note: You can hold to input fatalities, as long as is released before the last button in the Fatality sequence is pressed.

Comboality: Perform the pop-up combo on the final round of the match with your opponent's Health close to danger.
With the opponent airborn, connect the listed move after the Comboality to finish your opponent.

QUICK END SECTION:
With this option turned on (in the killer kodes menu), you can shorten the
amount of button presses you need to do a Fatality. The button to press is
based on the following:
1. If the move requires you to ), then is the quick end.
ex: Jax Arm blade fatal: ( ), ( ) so quick end is .
2. If the move requires you to hold down any other button besides than
the quick end is to charge and Release that button.
ex: Kano Skeleton Rip: ( ), ( ) so quick end is charge and
Release.
3. If the move has no buttons you hold down then the last button(s) and/or
direction pressed (or both a direction and button) is the quick end.
ex: Cyrax copter: ---- so quick end is .
ex: Liu Kang friend: - - - so quick end is

To play in the ENDURANCE MODE versus CPU by any commands, chosen by you:
TO GET IN A ENDURANCE MODE, THEN:
1) PUSH START ON FIRST AND SECOND JOYSTICKS
2) TO CHOOSE THE COMMAND OF THE FIRST PLAYER (YOUR COMMAND) ON FIRST JOYSTICK AND PUSH START
3) TO CHOOSE THE COMMAND OF THE SECOND PLAYER (COMMAND OF THE COMPUTER) ON SECOND JOYSTICK AND PUSH ON IT HOLD () + PUSH START AND AT ONCE Release START - 2 PLAYER WILL BE THE COMPUTER IF PUSH 2 PLAYER ARE SIMPLE START THAT WILL BE THE MAN.

DEMONSTRATION OF Fatality:

IN DEMONSTRATION OF Fatality 6 variants of realization are accessible:
How to choose variants of demonstration and their description:
1 variant: During occurrence of the first fight of demonstration, or at change of fight hold on first joystick (+C) - FIRST PLAYER - MAN, SECOND PLAYER - COMPUTER, AND COMPUTER RENDERS RESISTANCE

2 variant: During occurrence of the first fight of demonstration, or at change of fight hold on first joystick (X+A) - FIRST PLAYER - MAN, SECOND PLAYER - COMPUTER, AND COMPUTER DON'T RENDERS RESISTANCE (IT IS POSSIBLE TO Train And TO DO FINISH BY ALL FIGHTERS)

3 variant: During occurrence of the first fight of demonstration, or at change of fight hold on first joystick (Y+) - BOTH PLAYERS - COMPUTERS AND 1-ST PLAYER DOES FINISH TO SECOND.

4 variant: During occurrence of the first fight of demonstration, or at change of fight hold on first joystick (Z+C) - BOTH PLAYERS - COMPUTERS AND BOTH DO FINISH ONE TO ANOTHER

5 variant: During occurrence of the first fight of demonstration, or at change of fight hold on first joystick (A+) - BOTH PLAYERS - MAN'S AND MAY DO FINISH ONE TO ANOTHER

6 variant: During occurrence of the first fight of demonstration, or at change of fight hold on first joystick (A+C) - ORIGINAL DEMONSTRATION ALL FINISH BY THE COMPUTER

HOW TO CHOOSE IN ENDURANCE MODE: Kitana, Jade, Mileena, Scorpion, Reptile, Ermac, Classic Sub-Zero, Classic Smoke, Noob Saibot, Rain, Chameleon, Baraka, Liu Kang MK 2, Johnny Cage ,Kintaro ,Goro etc. - In The Shang Tsung PUSH BACK - WILL APPEAR THE BLACK SQUARE - IT'S Kitana. IF TO CONTINUE PUSH BACK - THAT WILL BE THE FOLLOWING FIGHTERS: Jade, Mileena, Scorpion, Reptile, Ermac, Classic Sub-Zero, Classic Smoke, Noob Saibot, Rain, Chameleon, Baraka, Liu Kang MK 2, Johnny Cage, Kintaro, Goro etc.
